name: image2-manga-page
title_zh: 一段人物关系，落成一页能读的黑白漫画
tagline_zh: 你只给角色、关系、场景和情绪，它自己决定分镜怎么切、哪格留白、网点贴多密、台词断在哪口气上——出来就是能读的一页。
tagline_en: You give characters, relationship, scene, mood. It decides panel cuts, which frame breathes, screentone density.
desc_en: Turn simple user-provided character, relationship, scene, and mood information into a readable one-page black-and-white manga image. The skill couples narrative, paneling, art direction, page hierarchy, density control, background density, character acting, screentone, black/white structure, and dialogue rhythm.
why_zh: 分镜、页内层级、密度和黑白结构是同一套决策，不是画完再排版。所以节奏能跟着情绪走，而不是跟着格子走。
why_en: Paneling, page hierarchy, density and B/W structure are one decision, not art-then-layout. Pacing follows the mood, not the grid.
limit_zh: 只出单页黑白，不给多页连载、不给彩页；设定太笼统（比如只说「两个人吵架」）它会先反问你关系与场景。
limit_en: Single B/W page only — no multi-page serials, no color. Vague premises get bounced back as questions; unresolved, it stops at draft-level paneling.
title_en: A character blurb, laid out as one readable B&W manga page
